body: I know day-to-day operations from hotel and front-desk environments and the everyday user, access and system questions small businesses face.

BIT offers clearly defined services for small businesses without in-house IT: user accounts, Microsoft 365, access and standardised workplace tasks. I stand behind the brand as owner and quality owner — not as an hourly ticket technician for every issue.
Legally BIT is a sole proprietorship. The contractual partner is BIT; I remain your contact for intake, written service frame, follow-up and billing.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions

items.q: Is BIT an in-house IT department?
items.a: No. BIT offers clearly scoped user, access and workplace services. The service frame is agreed in writing first.
Smaller companies with about 5–50 employees, mostly on Windows and Microsoft 365, without a dedicated IT role — Zurich and remote across Switzerland.

items.q: Can every IT problem be covered?
items.a: No. BIT takes on clearly scoped services within a written service frame. Complex infrastructure, vendor-dependent or specialist topics are not automatically included and are reviewed before work starts.

items.q: Does BIT only work with hotels?
items.a: No. Hotels and front desk are one experience example. The offer is aimed at smaller Swiss companies without in-house IT.

You engage the service with BIT. Before acceptance, BIT checks whether the required specialist work can be delivered within the available service and partner scope. Specialist work runs inside the confirmed BIT service; BIT remains the contact.
Permission and access changes only happen after documented approval and within the written service frame.

items.q: Are there fixed packages or prices?
items.a: The IT basics check is a fixed-price entry from CHF 190 with a written finding and priorities. Further work follows after review of need: setup, standardised fixed-price service, recurring service or special effort after prior approval. Most requests are handled remotely; Zurich-area on-site visits are agreed in advance and listed separately. Most requests are handled remotely. If an on-site appointment is required, it is agreed in advance and listed separately in the quote — Zurich area, with no hidden travel flat fee. Prices become binding only after written agreement. An hourly guideline may be quoted for approved special effort in exceptions, but it is not a core product.
